body:
Is this specific to 4.4.1 or does it also happen with 4.4 and earlier versions?

Can you share details about your Android device?

The logcat doesn't include details about the crash, only error messages emitted by Godot when it's closing and leaking static memory (this isn't critical and shouldn't cause a crash).
I suspect there might be details after this line:
```
 03-27 20:49:06.390 14944 14986 I godot :
```
but which do not contain the word `godot`, so they don't appear on your `grep`.
It would be also helpful if you can test with a non-c# export (non-c# editor and template) and confirm if its reproducible with a regular build or not.

Prior to 4.4.1-rc2, i was using 4.4-dev3 (.NET 8).  So in between those 2 versions, I didn't use others.  

With 4.4-dev3, I started to use C# cryptography elements because issue [GH-88803](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/88803) was fixed.  I haven't used enough of 4.4-dev3 to be certain that this crash behavior happened.

But from what I remember, prior to the fix of [GH-88803](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/88803), using C# cryptography elements crashes the Android app.

My android device is Google Pixel 4a

I will try and see more details of the logs again when the next crash happens (if and when it happens)
@cyberschema Does this only happen in your current project or you can also reproduce it in a new project?

> [@cyberschema](https://github.com/cyberschema) Does this only happen in your current project or you can also reproduce it in a new project?

It only happens in my current project, but I am trying to reproduce it with a new project.

This issue might be related to https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/103915, although that is for meta quest but from error log in that issue I think it could be related. https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/103915#issuecomment-2718915388

I was able to capture more detailed logs of more crashes.  This time, the crashes first started to happen about 10 minutes after I unplugged my Android device from my computer and then started the app.

With an effort in trying to reproduce these crashes, I deployed 4 types of projects to the Android.

1. Current project (.NET 9, Android) (Crashed)
2. Very basic project (.NET 8, Android) (Crashed)
3. Very basic project with a few lines of C# cryptography (.NET 8, Android) (No crash yet)
4. Very basic project (GDScript, Android) (No crash yet)

Two of the four apps crashed so far.  When the first app crashed, the second app also crashed too.  Any subsequent startup of the apps that had crashed, will also crash again.  The other two that haven't crashed yet are able to startup fine, so far.

Below are more detailed logs of the 2 crash examples.  Note, because of the privacy nature of the projects, I replaced sensitive text data with 'XXXXX'.
